hero.title: About EmpowerKids–South Sudan
hero.subtitle: Non‑governmental organisation · Founded 2014 · RRC Reg. No. 169 · Juba, South Sudan

whoWeAre.heading:
Verified impact.
Radical transparency.
whoWeAre.description1: EmpowerKids–South Sudan is a non‑governmental organisation registered under the NGO Act 2016 (RRC Reg. No. 169). Founded in 2014, we operate in Juba, Central Equatoria State. Our Juba Demonstration Farm is located at Juba 2, Gumbo‑Sherikat Area. Our programmes span education, agriculture, youth empowerment, and civic voice. Our work is validated by CAF America, allowing US donors to give tax‑deductibly.
whoWeAre.description2: Every figure on this page is taken directly from our programme monitoring records. Funders and evaluators can request the underlying data at any time — we have nothing to hide.
whoWeAre.missionStatement: To empower children, youth, and farmers in South Sudan through quality education, sustainable agriculture, and civic engagement.
whoWeAre.visionStatement: A South Sudan where every child can learn, every farmer can thrive, and every community has a voice.
whoWeAre.whereWeWorkStatement: Juba, Central Equatoria State; our demonstration farm in Juba 2 – Gumbo‑Sherikat; and youth activities across three states.

executiveDirector.name: Hakim Monykuer Awuok
executiveDirector.title: Executive Director
executiveDirector.bio: Hakim Monykuer Awuok is a public policy and governance professional with extensive experience in nonprofit leadership, currently serving as Executive Director of EmpowerKids–South Sudan. He brings expertise in strategic planning, partnership development, and programme management, driving the mission to create lasting impact for children and communities.
